about_the_game:
Journey Through a World Reclaimed by Nature and Madness

Prepare to embark on a mesmerizing journey into the heart of darkness as Whisper, a cloaked enigma draped in shadows, you'll find yourself in a world on the brink, a realm left unchecked for far too long. All cosmic life hangs on the balance of light and darkness. The blinding irradiated illumination that sparks existence across the cosmos, and the enigmatic darkness, who's emissaries are dispatched to worlds that have reached their 'inevitable' human conclusions.
But, when a single world seemingly slips far past it's planned reset, Our silent emissary is dispatched to uncover the keys to this worlds fate. Will you shut out the light for good, or forge your own moral choices within the darkness?





This 2D pixel art Metroidvania adventure beckons you to explore a realm of atmospheric, nonlinear wonder. Navigate branching paths, each concealing secrets waiting to be uncovered. With a vibrant pixel art style, paying homage to the classics while crafting an utterly immersive experience.
Accompanied by a soundtrack that adds depth and emotion to every moment of your journey.

Drawing inspiration from the timeless cinematic magic of Studio Ghibli, This world is more than meets the eye. It's a place where nature has reclaimed forgotten ruins, where ancient civilizations lie hidden beneath layers of mystery, and where the enigmatic and bizarre coexist harmoniously.



Your adventure is defined by your choices, shaped by your exploration, and illuminated by the nostalgia of classic pixel art. Uncover this worlds secrets, engage diverse hostile foes, and forge a connection with the life you seek to extinguish.

Are you ready to forge your own fate in the dark?

Game Features

  • A large interconnected world filled with mystery and wonder.
  • Smooth platforming and fast-paced combat.
  • Vibrant and colorful pixel art.
  • Use your sword, shadow bow, and hidden spells to fight bizarre foes.
  • Collect 'Relics' by defeating enemies and finding hidden treasure.
  • Purchase items and abilities to reach new heights, or hone your combat prowess.
  • NO soulslike elements, the game prioritizes fun and adventure over frustrating mechanics.
  • A beautiful soundtrack that brings the world to life.
  • Multiple endings that require you to make your own moral decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® 7 (32-bit/64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 class CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: %100 DirectX 9 compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10 (32-bit/64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5, AMD ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: %100 DirectX 9 compatible
